risk_per_trade: 0.3% of current capital, sized from stop distance; independent of leverage. Leverage (20x default) only scales required margin / max notional, per scalp_simulator.execute risk_budget vs margin_budget.
regime_filter: htf_adx (1h ADX14) <= 20 AND 1h range contained within the prior 24 1h bars (no fresh extreme). Opposite of S7 trend-only: absence of trend is required, not agreement with one.
entry: Resting limit order at VAL/VAH (profile_edge) or a rolling VWAP +/-1 sigma band (vwap_band), 6h window. Maker fee 2bps, no entry slippage, 120min TTL.
exit: Single fixed target = entry + side * tp_width_mult * (VAH-VAL), no trailing, no partial. Stop = level -/+ 0.25*ATR(14). Time-kill per max_hold_minutes.
selection: Stage 1: rank the 6 coarse (timeframe x tp_width_mult) variants at max_hold_minutes=90, >= 20 validation trades on the combined 4-pair portfolio. Stage 2: for the winning (timeframe, tp_width_mult), also test max_hold_minutes=60 and re-rank all 7 variants together. Freeze one global configuration before unused evaluation.
disclosure: December-March and August periods were used by earlier S7 revisions. April-July 2026 has not been used to pick parameters for S8 and is held aside as holdout. This is a retrospective screen, not real-time forward trading.
scenarios: 20x development; frozen holdout at 20x and 30x, with 2 and 5 bps slippage.
limit_model: Fills only if the bar actually trades through the level (2bps penetration), expires after 120 minutes. No same-fill-minute profit target. No queue model.
liquidation: Conservative deposit-vs-stop buffer only; no historical mark-price liquidation simulation.
stopping_rule: If no variant reaches profit_factor > 1 after costs on holdout for at least 3 of 4 pairs, S8 is a negative result. No further variant search follows a negative holdout.
